premises.text: Developers spend a significant amount of time in toil, which is tedious work arising from complexity.
premises.evidence_span: But developers spend half their week in toil. Toil is the tedious work in software creation that arises from complexity.

premises.text: Toil costs businesses over 85 billion dollars per year in wasted effort.
premises.evidence_span: This costs businesses over 85 billion dollars per year in wasted effort.

premises.text: Unhappy developers quit at one of the highest rates of any industry.
premises.evidence_span: Developers report that toil makes them unhappy and unhappy developers quit at one of the highest rates of any industry costing businesses heavily.

premises.text: Developers are lost in a maze of tools they don't control, which detracts from their coding.
premises.evidence_span: Developers are lost in a maze of tools they don't control away from the coding they love to do.

premises.text: AppMap provides personal observability, performance, and security analysis to developers.
premises.evidence_span: AppMap delivers personal observability, performance, and security analysis to developers when they work to reduce toil.

premises.text: AppMap provides accurate, up-to-date runtime information about software behavior.
premises.evidence_span: AppMaps are accurate, up-to-date, runtime information about the behavior of software as it is at any moment for any environment.

premises.text: AppMap can find performance and security issues in the code editor.
premises.evidence_span: Over half of today's performance issues are code-related like this, and no other tool can find them in the code editor.

premises.text: Companies adopting personal observability have faster time to code onboarding and reduce mean time to repair flaws.
premises.evidence_span: Companies adopting personal observability have faster time to code onboarding and reduce mean time to repair flaws from weeks down to minutes.

premises.text: AppMap is open source to integrate with new languages and communities.

premises.text: AppMap helps development teams reduce toil and ship more performance, secure, and reliable code faster.
